questions.quote: Basic Components of a map are title, legend, direction, scale and source.

en.q: Which of the following is NOT a basic component of a map?
en.explanation: The basic components of a map are title, legend, direction, scale and source.

questions.quote: There are at least three ways of representing scale. They are: 1. Statement Scale 2. Representative Fraction (R. F.) 3. Graphical or Bar Scale

en.q: Which of the following is NOT a way of representing the scale of a map?
en.explanation: The three ways are statement scale, representative fraction and graphical (bar) scale.

ta.q: வரைபட அளவுத்திட்டத்தைக் குறிக்கும் முறைகளில் ஒன்றல்லாதது எது?
ta.explanation: கூற்று, விகிதப் பின்னம், வரைபட (பட்டை) அளவுத்திட்டம் என மூன்று முறைகள் உள்ளன.

questions.quote: However, unlike the statement of the scale method, the graphical scale stands valid even when the map is reduced or enlarged. This is the unique advantage of the graphical method of representing scale.

en.q: What is the unique advantage of the graphical (bar) scale?
options: It remains valid even when the map is reduced or enlarged
It is written as a fraction
en.explanation: A statement scale such as '1 cm to 10 km' becomes wrong when the map is enlarged or reduced.

questions.quote: a fraction of 1 : 40,000 shows that one unit of length on the map represents 40,000 of the same units on the ground

en.q: A representative fraction of 1 : 40,000 means that
options: 40,000 units on the map represent one unit on the ground
one unit of length on the map represents 40,000 of the same units on the ground
1 cm on the map is 40 km on the ground
en.explanation: So 1 cm or 1 inch on the map represents 40,000 cm or 40,000 inches respectively on the ground.

en.q: Which is the most common method to measure the area of a region on a map?
en.explanation: In it, the area is covered by squares drawn on graph paper kept beneath the map or traced onto graph paper.
